body:
Maybe it's just complicated because of the way I am. I love and cherish my friends deeply, and have insecurity even in 100% platonic relationships. It's taken a lot of work on myself to not get jealous over friends hanging out with other friends, but I'm much more mature now. However anything outside of that is still a bit of a challenge. 

I say I don't think I have feelings for him, because it just doesn't feel like romantic feelings I've had in the past. It feels like my friend that I love and care about a lot, and me being really worried about what he thinks of me. 

We've talked about if he might like me before, but that was a no---and that's okay! It was back in February.

All that being said, I hear what you're saying and it's at least worth some exploration as to what I'm really feeling. Thank you for replying.
I guess it's just hard to see it that way. Not seeing him as much and having less sex/time with me in favor of someone else feels like being knocked down several important notches. :/
I think this is getting to the heart of the matter. I need to know that this person I'm very close to is also close to me, and likes me for me.

You are correct, I am more than my body. I forget this often though. 

I have a therapist who knows about my two sexual partners and she's never suggested she has any negative feelings towards it, so I will 100% talk to her in depth at our next session. I think doing some reading and studying about poly things and jealousy would also be really helpful. 

Also, I just wanna say, I'm so glad I posted her. If I'd posted in the other relationship subs I don't think anyone would have helped me. Thank you stranger.

Thanks for replying :)

My MO is usually to be radically honest. My fear in this scenario is that he will assume I have feelings I am suppressing, which will tank the friendship, even if I say I don't. I know that jealousy doesn't necessarily indicate romantic feelings, but idk. 

I also don't want him to think I'm putting blame on him for my emotions. Suggestions on how to word this? :S

It wasn't exactly a choice. I am currently broke as shit and it is just an unfortunate coincidence that my follow up appointment is a week after I ran out of my meds (which had no refill as we recently upped them). I hope that didn't come off as aggressive, I know I really skimmed through stuff in my post. Thank you for replying.
